spans.s: कृत् (I) vt. 6P (pp. कृत्त; pres. कृंतति) 1. To cut, to cut off, to divide, to tear asunder, to destroy, प्रहरति विधिर्मर्मच्छेदी न कृंतति जीवितम् M.M.ix., M.viii.12, Bt.xvi.15, ix.42, xv.97.With अव-, to cut off, to tear asunder, to divide.With उद्-, 1. to tear out, उत्क्रियोत्कृत्य कृतिम् M.M.v.; 2. to cut off, R.xii.49.With नि-, to cut off, to tear off, निकृंतान्निव मानसम् Bt.vii.11, भल्लनिकृत्तकंठैः R.vi.58.
कृत् (II) vt. 7P (pp. कृत्त) 1. To surround; 2. to spin.
कृत् (I) a. (generally at the end of compounds) doer, maker, performer, manufacturer, composer &c. See Bg.xv.15, M.i.18.
कृत् (II) m. 1. An affix used to form nouns from roots; 2. a noun formed by a Kṛt affix.
कॄत् vt. 10U (pp. कीर्तित; pres. कीर्तयति-ते) 1. To name, to mention, R.i.87, M.vii.167; 2. to commemorate, to praise, e.g. भ्रातुरचिकीर्तश्च विक्रमम् Bt.xv.72.
कृत (I) a. (f. ता) Done, performed, made, manufactured, (pp. of कृत् q.v.)

कृत (II) n. 1. Work, deed, movement, M.vii.197; 2. service, benefit; 3. consequence, result; 4. name of that side of a die which is marked with four points; 5. name of the first of the four Yugas of the world extending over 17,28,000 years of men, See M.i.69, and Kull. on it; 6. the number ‘4.’
कृत (I) a. (f. ता) Done, performed, made, manufactured, (pp. of कृत् q.v.)
कृत-अकृत a. done and not done, i.e. done in part but not completed.
कृत-अंक (I) a. 1. marked, branded, M.viii.281; 2. numbered.
कृत-अंक (II) m. that side of a die which is marked with four points.
कृत-अंजलि a. one who joins the hands in reverence, Bg.xi.14, M.iv.154.
कृत-अनुकर a. following another’s example, subservient.
कृत-अनुसार m. custom, usage.
कृत-अंत (I) a. causing an end, terminating.

कृत-अंत (II) m. 1. fate, destiny, न सहते संगमं नौकृतांतः Megh.ii.42; 2. Yama, the god of death, द्वितीयं कृतांतमिवाटंतं व्याधमपश्यत् Hit.i.); 3. a demonstrated conclusion, a dogma, a proved doctrine; 4. a sinful or inauspicious action; 5. an epithet of Saturn; 6. Saturday.
कृत-अंत˚जनक m. the sun.
कृत-अन्न n. 1. cooked food, कृतान्नमुदकं स्त्रियः M.iv.219, xi.3; 2. digested food, excrement.
कृत-अपराध a. guilty, criminal.
कृत-अभय a. saved from fear or danger.
कृत-अभिषेक a. crowned, inaugurated.
कृत-अभ्यास a. practised.
कृत-अर्थ a. 1. successful; 2. satisfied, contented, कृतः कृतार्थोऽस्मि निबर्हितांहसा Sis.i.29, R.viii.3; 3. clever. (कृतार्थीकृ ‘to maintain,’ कांतं प्रत्युपचारतश्चतुरया कोपः Am.
कृत-अवधान a. 1. careful, cautious; 2. attentive.
कृत-अवधि a. fixed, appointed, bounded, limited.
कृत-अवस्थ a. 1. summoned, made present; 2. fixed, settled.
कृत-अस्त्र a. 1. armed; 2. skilled in the practice of arms.
कृत-आगम (I) a. advanced, proficient.
कृत-आगम (II) m. the supreme soul.
कृत-आगस् a. offending, criminal, sinful.
कृत-आत्मन् a. 1. having control over himself, of a self-governed spirit; 2. purified in mind.
कृत-आभरण a. adorned.
कृत-आयास a. labouring, suffering.
कृत-आह्वान a. challenged.
कृत-उत्साह a. making effort, striving.
कृत-उद्वाह a. 1. making penance by standing with up-lifted hands; 2. married.
कृत-उपकार a. 1. befriended, assisted; 2. friendly.
कृत-उपभोग a. used, enjoyed.
कृत-कर्मन् (I) a. 1. one who has done his work, R.ix.3; 2. skilful, clever.
कृत-कर्मन् (II) m. 1. the supreme spirit; 2. a sannyāsin.
कृत-काम a. one whose desire is attained.
कृत-काल (I) a. fixed or settled as to time.
कृत-काल (II) m. appointed time, Yaj.ii.184.
कृत-कृत्य a. 1. who has accomplished or attained his object, Bg.xv.20; 2. satisfied, contented, Sant.S.iii.19.
कृत-क्रय m. a purchaser.
कृत-क्षण a. 1. one who is waiting impatiently for the exact moment, e.g. कृतक्षणोहं ते गमनं प्रति; 2. one who has got an opportunity.
कृत-घ्न a. 1. ungrateful, M.iv.214; 2. defeating all previous measures.
कृत-चूड m. a boy on whom the ceremony of tonsure has been performed, M.v.58.
कृत-ज्ञ (I) a. 1. grateful, M.vii.209, 210; 2. correct in conduct.
कृत-ज्ञ (II) m. a dog.
कृत-तीर्थ a. 1. one who has visited holy places; 2. one who has studied with a professional teacher; 3. fertile in expedients.
कृत-दास m. a servant hired for a stated period.
कृत-धी a. 1. prudent, considerate; 2. learned, educated.
कृत-निर्णेजन m. a penitent.
कृत-निश्चय a. resolved.
कृत-पुंख a. skilled in archery.
कृत-पूर्व a. done formerly.
कृत-प्रतिकृत n. assault and counter-assault, R.xii.94.
कृत-प्रतिज्ञ a. 1. one who has taken a vow; 2. one who has fulfilled his promise.
कृत-बुद्धि a. learned, educated, wise, M.i.97.
कृत-मुख a. learned, wise.
कृत-लक्षण a. 1. stamped, branded, M.ix.239; 2. excellent, amiable; 3. defined, discriminated.
कृत-विद्य a. learned, सुवर्णपुष्पितां पृथ्वीं विचिन्वंति त्रयो जनाः । शूरश्च कृतविद्यश्च यश्च जानाति सेवितुम् Panch.i.
कृत-वेतन a. hired, paid, (as a servant), Yaj.ii.164.
कृत-वेदिन् a. See कृतज्ञ.
कृत-वेश a. attired, decorated, गतवति कृतवेशे केशवे कुंजशय्याम् Git.G.xi.
कृत-शोभ a. 1. splendid; 2. beautiful; 3. dexterous.
कृत-शौच a. purified.
कृत-श्रम a. studied, e.g. पुराणे कृतश्रमः ‘who has spent his labours over Purāṇa, i.e. who has studied that branch of literature.’
कृत-संकल्प a. resolved, determined.
कृत-संकेत a. making an appointment, नामसमेतं कृतसंकेतं वादयते मृदुवेणुम् Git.G.v.
कृत-संज्ञ a. restored to consciousness or animation.
कृत-संनाह a. cased in armour.
कृत-सापत्निका f. a woman whose husband has married another wife, a married woman having a co-wife.
कृत-हस्त, -हस्तक a. 1. dexterous, clever, skilful; 2. skilled in archry.
कृत-हस्त, -हस्तक a. 1. dexterous, clever, skilful; 2. skilled in archry.
कृत-हस्तता f. 1. skill, dexterity; 2. skill in handling arms, कौरव्ये कृतहस्तता पुनरियं देवे यथा सीरिनि Ve.vi.

कृतक a. (f. का) 1. Done, created, e.g. यद्यत्कृतं तत्तदनित्यम्; 2. artificial, कृतकविधिसर्वांगीणमाकल्पजातम् R.xviii.52; 3. adopted (as a son), यस्योपेतं कृतकतनयः कांतया वर्धितो मे (बालमंदारवृक्षः) Megh.ii.12; 4. assumed, simulated, false, कृतककलहं कृत्वा स्वतंत्रेन किंचित् कालांतर व्यवहर्तव्यमित्यार्यादेशः Mud.iii.

कृतक a. (f. का) 1. Done, created, e.g. यद्यत्कृतं तत्तदनित्यम्; 2. artificial, कृतकविधिसर्वांगीणमाकल्पजातम् R.xviii.52; 3. adopted (as a son), यस्योपेतं कृतकतनयः कांतया वर्धितो मे (बालमंदारवृक्षः) Megh.ii.12; 4. assumed, simulated, false, कृतककलहं कृत्वा स्वतंत्रेन किंचित् कालांतर व्यवहर्तव्यमित्यार्यादेशः Mud.iii.
कृतम् ind. Enough, no more of, (with the inst.), अथवा कृतं संदेहेन Sak.i., अथवा गिरा कृतम् R.xi.41.

कृति f. 1. Doing, manufacturing; 2. action; 3. creation, work, composition, श्रीश्रीहर्षकवेः कृतिः कृतिमुदे तस्याभ्युदीयादियम् Na.xxii.155, R.xv.33, 64, 69; 4. magic, enchantment; 5. injuring, killing; 6. the number ‘20’.
कृत्ति f. 1. Skin, hide, especially the hide of an antelope on which a religious student sits; 2. the bark of the birch tree used for writing; 3. one of the lunar mansions, Pleiades.
कृति-कर m. an epithet of Rāvaṇa.

कृतिन् a. (f. नी) (often used as a noun) 1. Expert, clever, wise, learned, तं क्षुरप्रशकलीकृतं कृती R.xi.29, Kir.ii.9; 2. good, virtuous, pious, तावदेवकृतिनामपि स्फुरस्येव निर्मलविवेकदीपकः Bhartr.i.56; 3. fortunate, lucky; 4. obeying, doing what is enjoined; 5. one who has done his work or obtained his desire, satisfied, contented, न खल्वनिर्जित्य रघुं कृती भवान् R.iii.51, xii.64.

कृतिन् a. (f. नी) (often used as a noun) 1. Expert, clever, wise, learned, तं क्षुरप्रशकलीकृतं कृती R.xi.29, Kir.ii.9; 2. good, virtuous, pious, तावदेवकृतिनामपि स्फुरस्येव निर्मलविवेकदीपकः Bhartr.i.56; 3. fortunate, lucky; 4. obeying, doing what is enjoined; 5. one who has done his work or obtained his desire, satisfied, contented, न खल्वनिर्जित्य रघुं कृती भवान् R.iii.51, xii.64.
कृते ind. (with a gen. if not compounded) For, for the sake of, on account of, अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते Bg.i.35, Yaj.i.216, विधिना कस्य कृते विनिर्मिता R.G.
कृते ind. (with a gen. if not compounded) For, for the sake of, on account of, अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते Bg.i.35, Yaj.i.216, विधिना कस्य कृते विनिर्मिता R.G.
कृत्ति-वास, -वासस् m. an epithet of Śiva, स कृत्तिवासास्तपसे यतात्मा K.S.i.54.
कृत्ति-वास, -वासस् m. an epithet of Śiva, स कृत्तिवासास्तपसे यतात्मा K.S.i.54.
कृत्तिका f. pl. 1. The third of the 27 constellations consisting of 6 stars, the Pleiades; 2. those six stars represented as six nymphs nursing Kārtikeya, the god of war.
कृत्तिका-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
कृत्तिका-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
कृत्तिका-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
कृत्तिका-भव m. the moon.
कृत्नु (I) a. 1. Working well, able to work powerful; 2. skilful.
कृत्नु (II) m. A mechanic, an artist.
कृत्य (I) a. (f. त्या) 1. What ought to be done, right, proper; 2. practicable; 3. who may be seduced from allegiance.
कृत्य (II) n. 1. Work, deed, action, commission, कूजद्भिरापादितवंशकृत्यम् R.ii.12, 51; 2. duty, M.ii.237; 3. purpose, end; 4. motive, cause.
कृत्य (III) m. A class of affixes forming future passive participles &c., (e.g. तव्य, अनीय, य, एलिम).
कृत्य (I) a. (f. त्या) 1. What ought to be done, right, proper; 2. practicable; 3. who may be seduced from allegiance.
कृत्या f. 1. Action, deed; 2. magic; 3. a female deity to whom sacrifices are offered for destructive purposes.
कृत्रिम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Artificial, not spontaneous, R.xiii.75, xix.37; 2. adopted (as a child).
कृत्रिम (II) m. A grown up boy who is adopted without the consent of his natural parents (कृत्रिमः स्यात् स्वयंकृतः Yaj.ii.131, M.ix.159, 169.)
कृत्रिम (III) n. 1. A kind of salt; 2. a kind of perfume.
कृत्रिम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Artificial, not spontaneous, R.xiii.75, xix.37; 2. adopted (as a child).
कृत्रिम-धूप, -धूपक m. incense, a kind of perfume.
कृत्रिम-धूप, -धूपक m. incense, a kind of perfume.
कृत्रिम-पुत्र m. See कृत्रिम II.
कृत्रिम-पुत्रक m. a doll.
कृत्रिम-भूमि f. an artificial floor.
कृत्रिम-वन n. a park, a garden.
कृत्वस् ind. (at the end of numerals) Fold, times, e.g. दशकृत्व ‘ten times,’ M.ii.79.
कृत्स (I) n. 1. Water; 2. a multitude.
कृत्स (II) m. Sin.
कृत्स्न a. (f. त्स्ना) All, whole, entire, Bg.iii.29, M.i.105, v.42.
कृत्स्न a. (f. त्स्ना) All, whole, entire, Bg.iii.29, M.i.105, v.42.
